summary: Phase 1 implementation is solid. 7 tasks across 3 waves deliver a coherent project structure with filesystem persistence, migration, sidebar navigation, editor integration, and version history. Critical snapshot content bug was caught by business testing and fixed inline. Remaining findings are minor — none block progression.

issues.title: window.location.reload() after snapshot restore
issues.description: handleRestore uses window.location.reload() to refresh UI after restoring a snapshot. This causes full page reload, losing all in-memory state (other open panels, unsaved sidebar state, etc.).
issues.recommendation: Replace with store dispatch to update currentChapterContent + re-render. Low urgency — works correctly, just jarring UX.

issues.title: getSnapshot returns untyped any
issues.description: getSnapshot returns JSON.parse(raw) without type annotation. Should return Snapshot | null for consistency with the rest of the typed codebase.
issues.recommendation: Add explicit return type annotation: Promise<Snapshot | null>.

issues.title: SnapshotIndex stores full Snapshot objects including content
issues.description: index.json stores complete Snapshot objects (including potentially large content fields) in the array. For chapters with many snapshots, this file could become large.
issues.recommendation: Consider storing only metadata in index.json and loading content on demand from individual snapshot files. Low urgency — 50-snapshot cap with enforceRetentionPolicy mitigates this.

issues.title: Migration service directly imports useAppStore
issues.description: migrateFromLocalStorage calls useAppStore.getState() and useAppStore.setState() directly, creating tight coupling between the service layer and the store.
issues.recommendation: Accept store actions as parameters (dependency injection) for testability. Low urgency — migration is a one-time operation.

issues.title: plainTextToTipTap creates empty paragraph nodes for blank lines
issues.description: When converting plain text with blank lines, creates { type: 'paragraph' } without a content array. TipTap handles this gracefully but it's technically invalid per the TipTap doc schema.
issues.recommendation: Add empty content: [] array to paragraph nodes for schema compliance.

strengths: Clean separation of concerns: types → services → stores → components
Consistent use of Tauri FS plugin (readTextFile/writeTextFile) throughout persistence layer
Atomic project creation (project + volume + chapter in single set() call) prevents partial state
Backup-before-write migration pattern is robust and includes validation step
Auto-save throttling (5 min) and retention policy (50 max, preserve named) are well-implemented
TipTap JSON preservation through snapshot content field fix ensures faithful restoration
ID generation with crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8) is simple and collision-resistant enough for the scale

architecture_notes.persistence: Tauri FS plugin with JSON files under projects/{id}/ structure
architecture_notes.versioning: Snapshot files with SHA-256 content hash, Myers diff for text comparison
